ABOUT PRIME DOMESTIC

A small family-run cleaning team from Malvern East. No call centre, no big franchise, just us.

Prime Domestic and Cleaning Services is a family business based in Malvern East. It's led by Derick, with his wife and a couple of trusted helpers, and we look after homes across Melbourne's south-east.

We started because we kept hearing the same thing from friends and neighbours: cleaners who don't turn up, prices that change on the day, and a different stranger every visit. We thought: we can do better than that.

So we keep things simple. We quote clearly, we turn up when we say we will, and we clean your home the way we'd want ours cleaned. If something isn't right, we come back and fix it.

What we care about

Clean means clean

We clean your kitchen and bathroom the way we'd want ours done: properly, not just quickly.

Familiar faces

Regular clients usually see the same small team. No strangers, no re-explaining where the spare towels go.

Honest prices

You see an estimate before you book and we confirm the final price before we start.

We own our mistakes

Tell us within 24 hours (72 hours for end of lease agent reports) and we'll come back and fix it, free.

FAQS

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to be home?

Not at all. Many clients arrange access for the day, like a key left in an agreed spot or a neighbour letting us in. We don't keep keys or record codes.

Do you bring your own supplies?

Yes. We bring all equipment and products, low-tox where possible. We only need water and power onsite.

Is the online price final?

It's an estimate based on what you tell us. We confirm the final price before we start, so there are no surprises.

What if I'm not happy?

Tell us within 24 hours (photos help) and we'll come back and fix anything on our checklist, at no cost. For end of lease cleans, you have 72 hours to pass on anything the agent flags.

I have a dog. Is that okay?

Absolutely. We love pets, we just ask that they're secured while we work, mainly so they don't 'help' with the mop.

Ready for a cleaner home and a free weekend?

Get your estimate in about a minute, or just call or message us. We're real people, and we reply.
